archetype: Organic & Earthy meets Contemporary Italian Hospitality (Moderno ma non troppo)

typography.pairing_rationale: Lora gives the artisanal, warm Italian culinary/hospitality dignity without looking antiquated, while Plus Jakarta Sans delivers crisp, frictionless SaaS usability for mobile menu reading and dashboard forms.

entry_surfaces./: split hero with live interactive Italian menu preview card right and value prop CTA left on warm linen background
entry_surfaces./login: split branded auth with Italian hospitality testimonial and imagery left, crisp secure login form right
entry_surfaces./register: split branded auth with 7-day free trial guarantee highlight left, streamlined 2-minute setup form right

landing_hero_dishes.description: Pizza artigianale Margherita cotta a legna con pomodoro San Marzano e fior di latte
Pasta fresca al pesto ligure con calice di vino bianco
Interno accogliente con tavoli in legno e lampade a sospensione calde
Salone di parrucchiere e barberia artigianale con taglio e styling

landing.header: Sticky crystal glass nav with MenuSito logo (warm terracotta fork-spark icon), quick links (Funzionalità, Come Funziona, Prezzi, Esempi), 'Accedi' button and 'Crea il tuo Menu Gratis' CTA
landing.hero_layout: Asymmetric 12-column grid: 7 cols left with bold editorial typography ('Il tuo Menù Digitale e Sito Veloce, pronto in 2 minuti'), 7-giorni prova badge, CTA buttons, and 5 cols right with dynamic smartphone mockup showing real interactive restaurant menu with live allergen tags & quick call buttons
landing.features_grid: Tetris Bento grid highlighting: 1. Generatore QR Code Alta Risoluzione con download SVG/PNG; 2. Bottoni Azione Rapida (Chiama, WhatsApp, Maps); 3. Gestore Listino & Allergeni; 4. Prova 7 giorni senza carta di credito
landing.live_demo_selector: Interactive preview where users can switch between 'Trattoria Bella Napoli' (Pizzeria/Rist), 'Bistrot Milano Centrale' (Cocktail & Caffè), and 'Atelier Barber & Hair' (Servizi salone)
landing.pricing_section: Transparent card detailing the 7-day free trial leading into €29/mese Pro plan, highlighting unlimited scans, unlimited dishes, custom cover & logo, and direct WhatsApp reservations

owner_dashboard.structure: Sidebar + Header + Multi-tab workspace. Sidebar contains 'Panoramica', 'Dati Locale', 'Listino & Menu', 'QR Code & Download', 'Abbonamento & Piano Pro', and quick button 'Vedi Pagina Pubblica'
owner_dashboard.business_info_tab: Clean structured form: Nome locale, Categoria (Ristorante, Pizzeria, Bar/Bistrot, Parrucchiere/Salone), Città, Indirizzo, Telefono, Numero WhatsApp per prenotazioni, Orari di apertura settimanali (Lunedì-Domenica con orario spezzato o continuato), Descrizione accattivante, Logo upload e Cover Image upload
owner_dashboard.menu_editor_tab: Drag-and-drop or categorized accordion tree: Manage categories (e.g., Antipasti, Primi, Pizze Speciali, Bevande / Taglio, Piega, Colore). Inside each category: Item title, description, price (formatted in EUR €), image upload/selector, allergen checkboxes (Glutine, Lattosio, Frutta a guscio, ecc.), and 'Disponibile / Esaurito' toggle
owner_dashboard.qr_generator_tab: Interactive high-res QR Code studio with customizable frame styles ('Inquadra per il Menu', 'Tavolo N°', minimal), color picker, and 1-click Download buttons (PNG Alta Risoluzione 300dpi, SVG Vettoriale per stampa tipografica)
owner_dashboard.subscription_tab: Clear visual countdown banner: 'Ti rimangono X giorni di prova gratuita' with instant 'Attiva Piano Pro (29€/mese)' simulated checkout modal with card input or 1-click test checkout, generating active subscription badges and invoice preview

public_mobile_page.concept: App-like mobile-first experience. Header with cover photo, restaurant logo avatar, title, category, city, and badge 'Aperto ora / Chiuso'.
public_mobile_page.quick_actions_bar: Sticky bottom or prominent top floating action buttons: 1. 'Chiama Ora' (tel: link), 2. 'WhatsApp' (direct pre-filled message 'Ciao, vorrei prenotare...'), 3. 'Google Maps' (navigation link)
public_mobile_page.category_nav: Sticky horizontal scrolling category chips with smooth scroll to section (#antipasti, #pizze, ecc.)
public_mobile_page.menu_items_list: Clean food cards with high-res dish photography, bold price tag (€XX,XX), ingredient descriptions, and allergen icon pills
public_mobile_page.blocked_trial_screen: Graceful branded lock screen when trial is expired: 'Il periodo di prova di questo locale è terminato. Se sei il proprietario, accedi alla dashboard per attivare il Piano Pro e riattivare la visualizzazione per i tuoi clienti.'

motion.page_transitions: Subtle fade-in and translateY(8px) with motion/react
motion.qr_preview: scale hover 1.02 with soft shadow expansion
motion.mobile_modal: slide-up sheet for dish details or allergen information

accessibility.contrast_standard: APCA & WCAG AA certified. All text over background maintains at least 4.5:1 ratio.
accessibility.touch_targets: Minimum 44x44px for all mobile action buttons (Chiama, WhatsApp, Maps, Category tabs)
accessibility.screen_readers: All action icons paired with sr-only labels or visible Italian text
accessibility.focus_states: High-contrast ring-2 ring-stone-800 ring-offset-2 on all inputs and buttons

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Keep all user-facing copy strictly in natural, professional Italian (e.g. 'Menù Digitale', 'Scarica QR Code', 'Prenota su WhatsApp', 'Listino Piatti', 'Orari di Apertura', 'Prova gratuita 7 giorni').
2. Ensure the public page /locale/:slug is ultra-responsive, snappy and feels like a native mobile app when accessed on smartphones.
3. Implement the QR Code generator using a robust canvas/SVG library (like qrcode.react) with quick download for PNG and table stand template print view.
4. Support local storage or MongoDB persistence for user locales, menu items, categories, and subscription state with full CRUD.

5. Provide pre-seeded realistic Italian demo venues: e.g. 'Trattoria Da Mario' (Roma), 'Pizzeria Bella Napoli' (Napoli), 'Bar Principe' (Firenze), 'Barberia San Babila' (Milano) so the app is instantly rich with authentic Italian food and service data.
6. Include the simulated 7-day trial countdown and a toggleable 'Simula Scadenza Prova' button in dashboard to test both active and expired public page states.
